title: Water Shutoff — South Area — Jul 20
public_detail: Scheduled Water Shut-Off – South potable Scheduled Water Shut-Off Dear Residents, Please be advised that the potable water service will be temporarily shut off in the South section of the community on Thursday, July 23, 2026 beginning at 9:00am for approximately 2 hours. This shut-off is being completed at the request of a resident, with approval from park management, to address necessary maintenance. When water service is restored, please run water through your bathtub faucet or another spigot without a filter for several minutes to clear any air or sediment from the lines. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding. If you have any questions, please contact the park office. Sincerely, Park Management Top of Form Bottom of Form Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
